name: Green Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1974 and headquartered in Seosan, South Korea, Green Chemical Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer and distributor of essential chemical compounds. The company's diverse product portfolio includes ethylene oxide adducts (EOA), ethanolamines, dimethyl carbonates, and acrylate monomers. Green Chemical's EOA range is extensive, featuring various polyoxyethylene alkyl and phenyl ethers, polyoxyethylene glycols, polyoxyalkylene glycol mono butyl ethers, anti-foaming agents, copolymers, alkyl phenol-free surfactants, and polycarboxylates, among others. Its ethanolamines are integral components in a multitude of sectors, seeing use in detergents, emulsifiers, gas refining, agricultural chemicals, cosmetics, metalworking fluids, semiconductor stripping, and cement additives. Dimethyl carbonates provided by the company act as crucial intermediate materials for polycarbonates, serve as diluents for paints and pigments, function as electrolytes in secondary batteries, work as coating solvents, find application as fuel additives, and are vital in organic synthesis, often substituting other organic solvents. Furthermore, Green Chemical supplies a comprehensive selection of acrylate monomers, encompassing monofunctional, difunctional, trifunctional, and multifuncational acrylates, alongside their monofunctional, difunctional, and trifunctional methacrylate counterparts.
